SELECT
  LEFT(c.customer_id, 10) AS customer_id,
  LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10) AS customer_unique_id,
  ABS(COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0))::numeric AS total_spent,
  CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0)) DESC) AS INTEGER) AS rank_by_total_spent
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY
  rank_by_total_spent ASC;
